raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Accomplished Certified SAFe® 6 Agilist, Payments Technology Delivery Lead, and Senior Technical BA/Project Manager with over 17 years of experience in the banking and fintech domains. Proven expertise in leading complex payment system transformations, ISO 20022 messaging migrations, real-time payment (RTP) implementations, and core cards authorization platforms. Hands-on experience across full SDLC, technical backlog refinement, and API/database-level integration management. Skilled at bridging the gap between business, core engineering, and cross-functional technology teams to drive predictable release management, robust production support, and seamless delivery.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Payments & Banking Domain: ISO 20022 Messaging Transformation & Migration (pac.008, pain.001, camt.053),
Real-Time Payments (RTP), Transaction Lifecycle (Initiation, Authorization, Capture, Clearing & Settlement), ISO 8583, Prepaid & Card Processing Systems.
Technology Delivery & SDLC: Technical Business Analysis, Systems Architecture & Data Mapping, Project Planning & Release Management, Production Support Oversight, API/Interface Dependency Management, CI/CD Pipeline Integration (Jenkins/Git).
Agile & SAFe Governance: SAFe 6.0, Scrum, Kanban | Program Increment (PI) Planning, Scrum of Scrums (SoS),
Backlog Refinement, Value Stream Mapping, RAID Management, Financial & Resource Capacity Planning.
Technical Skills & Tools: SQL / PL-SQL Data Querying & Analysis, Database Migration (Oracle/Relational/NoSQL), REST/SOAP APIs, JIRA, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Confluence, AI-Augmented Analytics (Copilot, ChatGPT).
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Payments & ISO 20022 Modernization: Successfully led end-to-end technical delivery and messaging
transformations (including ISO 20022 and Real-Time Payments) across major banking and global payment networks.
Enterprise Delivery Predictability: Elevated release predictability from 60% to 90%+ across multi-team Agile
Release Trains (ARTs) by defining clear DoR/DoD criteria, refining story technical specifications, and implementing built-in quality frameworks.
Technical Debt & Defect Reduction: Secured dedicated Innovation & Planning (IP) iteration capacity for core cards
authorization platforms, yielding a 30% reduction in production escaped defects and a 20% decrease in technical debt.
Global Stakeholder Management: Spearheaded delivery and technical alignment across 8+ international cross-
functional technology teams (APMEA, US, and EU regions) delivering enterprise payment platforms.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Endava — India | Technology Project Manager / Technical BA • July 2025 – Present

Lead technology delivery and business analysis for the FinTech Real-Time Payments (RTP) ART, driving hands-on implementation and migration of ISO 20022 payment messaging standards (pain, pacs, and camt formats).
Direct PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt (I&A) sessions, boosting ART release predictability from 70%
to 90% and velocity by 20% within two Program Increments.
Collaborate with product managers, system architects, and dev leads to perform data field mapping, API interface
specifications, and database query (SQL) validations for transaction processing.
Facilitate cross-team technical dependency tracking using ROAM matrices, overseeing release management and

production support protocols. Leverage DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git) for tracking CI/CD release readiness and integrate AI toolsets (Copilot, ChatGPT) for backlog refinement and delivery intelligence.
Tetra Pak — India | Senior Scrum Master / Service Delivery Manager • July 2023 – April 2025
Governed digital service operations, encompassing financial tracking, budget forecasting, SLA compliance, and
leadership over multiple Project Managers across the digital portfolio.
• Conducted refined user story workshops for Centre of Excellence Scrum teams, improving story quality metrics from
6/10 to 9/10 and curtailing scope creep by 40%.
Optimized delivery throughput by analyzing JIRA flow metrics, cutting average cycle time from 12 to 8 days.
Capgemini Technologies — India | Engagement Manager / Technical Delivery Lead • Sept 2021 – July 2023
Barclays Project (Banking): Managed end-to-end payment technology delivery, supervising scope, milestone
schedules, cross-functional engineering dependencies, production readiness, and governance protocols; maintained robust RAID logs and SQL database integration tracking.
Discover Financial Services Project: Functioned as Technical Delivery Lead & Senior Scrum Master for a 30+
member initiative enhancing the core Cards Authorization platform. Led ISO 20022 messaging adoption and ISO 8583 transaction processing analysis across 6 cross-functional engineering teams. Accelerated time-to-market by 25% via Scrum of Scrums while lowering escaped production defects by 30% and debt by 20% through structured IP iteration planning.
Alliance Data Card Services Project: Led high-performing technology teams executing a major legacy mainframe
migration to the Fiserv Omaha processing platform. Managed complex data mapping, relational database conversions (Oracle/NoSQL), and third-party API dependencies, achieving a 95% sprint commitment reliability rate.
Mastercard — India | Scrum Master & Senior Technical Business Analyst • Aug 2015 – Sept 2021
Cash Passport Program: Acted as Technical BA & Scrum Master for the global Cash Passport prepaid mobile
platform, leading end-to-end requirements, payment gateway integrations, ISO payment messaging standards, and production support across 8+ international technology teams in APMEA, US, and EU markets.
Enterprise Web Portals: Led technical business analysis and systems engineering for global content portals
(Mastercard.com and Priceless.com) powered by Adobe Experience Manager (AEM); authored technical user stories, defined API integration criteria, and directed UAT/Release Management cycles.
Dell International — India | Business Analyst • Oct 2011 – Aug 2015
Served as Business Analyst for enterprise CMS and SharePoint ecosystems across Dell.com; engineered process
maps, authored business requirements, and led taxonomy and workflow solutions.
EARLY CAREER
Jabil Global Services / Definity First — Poland & Mexico | Programming Analyst / Web Developer • July 2009 – Dec 2010
Developed custom application modules, SQL database queries, and custom enterprise workflows.
